title: ARM-HandModifi
description: This mod enables full customization of Minecraft character hands, letting players precisely adjust their position, size, blending (X/Y/Z), and rotation in 3D space to suit their preferences.
body:
Arm-HandModifi

_This mod provides a fully functional tool for detailed customization of the character’s hand appearance and behavior in Minecraft. It offers extensive personalization options, allowing players to adapt the visual aspect to their preferences and playstyle._

Open menu settings: **"N"**

Key features:

```
The mod gives full control over the following parameters:
Hand position (left and right separately) — precise adjustment of position in space.
Hand size — scaling relative to the default appearance.
Blending along axes (X, Y, Z) — smooth position adjustment with micrometric precision.
Rotation along axes (X, Y, Z) — adjustment of the tilt angle for each hand in 3D space.
```
